notes.title: My Breast Friend Sally Version 2 Releases Just in Time For Summer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37283649/6f519ce908fbcdb29abd753b8f0791bc0392c24c.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, cowpokes![/b]

My Breast Friend Sally Version 2 is almost ready for release with tons of new content.

The new content will be available for free to those who previously purchased the game on Steam.

[b]- Complete application overhaul

- New content for Fiona and Eva

- New minor characters

- New minigames

- GUI fixes

- Remixed Music

- Additional Voice Acting 

- New config features

- Updated menus

- In-app localizations for Chinese (simplified) and Russian, with more to come in future patches 

- Bug fixes[/b]

Have a deMOOnstrably good time!

notes.title: Short and Sweet "My Breast Friend Sally" to release in very soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37283649/669be890668fb14ee876c3607d5660e83c99bb54.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! Just wanted to let you guys know that this title will be releasing on time in the next few hours. Breast Friend Sally is the beginning of our partnership with a Kupaa who we eventually convinced to start making games!

As we said above Sally is a neat short and sweet story. Despite its production quality we will be selling this title for only 5.99 at a 10% discount at launch. Supporting this visual novel will give Kupaa and their large assortment of artist the confidence to make bigger and better things. 

Thanks guys!

________________________________________

Love seeing western stylization? Then make sure to check out some of the the other games we have planned at our publisher page! Give us a follow to keep up to date with all the crazy shit we got planned.
